title: I watched more of my competitors' reels than I made my own. So I got AI to review mine against theirs.
hook: I watched more of my competitors' reels than I made my own. So I got AI to review mine against theirs.
summary: Metricool: scheduled Fri 2026-10-23 13:00 IG + TikTok. Carousel 88 (STACK-26), 7 slides, house look.
body: Metricool: scheduled Fri 2026-10-23 13:00 IG + TikTok. Carousel 88 (STACK-26), 7 slides, house look.
guide: Use AI to study creators you admire, turn what you learn into a checklist, then have it review your own videos against that checklist. You need a ChatGPT or Claude account, the videos or transcripts of creators you respect, and your own videos.
1. Pick a handful of creators whose videos you admire and collect a few of their best videos, as links, transcripts or screen recordings.
1. Give them to ChatGPT or Claude and ask what the videos have in common: how they open, how fast they move, how they are edited and how they close.
1. Ask the assistant to turn those findings into a checklist covering hooks, pacing and style.
1. Add your own video, as a transcript or an upload where the tool accepts video, and ask for a review against the checklist.
1. Ask for the answer as two short lists: "do this" and "stop doing this", each tied to a moment in your video.
1. Apply the changes in your editor, such as CapCut, and run the next video through the same review.
1. Update the checklist as you learn what works for your own audience.
Watch out: the checklist describes what makes other people's videos work, so use it to improve your own style and don't copy their scripts or delivery.
